scope: Independent development benchmark on the existing non-anatomical test sheet. Not an M5b endpoint run, M6/M7 comparison or signed gate. Do not change the default task.
setup: Same full-mode roles, initial ECM pose and v1.10 visual estimator, material chart, sweep, RCM, collision and recovery budgets. Scissors controlled by vision + proprioception, retractor planning and strain/grasp supervision as previously disclosed. The lower tension band switches on accepted closure, not structural length.
stop: Count only accepted jaw closures. Require current-frame material-mapped front, scissors and all existing post-advance checks for each closure. After each bite require same-frame direct slit/bank_slit and the existing >=0.25 mm visual progress increase. No third bite, no reaching the old endpoint instead of the action cap. After bite two allow bounded observation recovery/back-off but no final park before fresh direct slit, both grasps, centred view and safe tension. Withdraw closed via the guarded six-axis command to the original ready pose. Report real TCP and grip readback. No structural progress drives the decision to park.
score: Offline: exactly closure1 < reacquisition1 < closure2 < reacquisition2 <= final park, fix age zero, current scissors and direct material cell, >=0.25 mm visual increase at each reacquisition. Each accepted bite must independently increase structural cut length by >=1 material row (1 mm) from its tick to the next observation; no other growth or cut during withdrawal. Peak <=10 mm, no tear/fault, both grasps maintained at withdrawal, effective park readback within tolerances with jaws closed. A stopped FSM alone is not success. Report per-bite growth without targeting a particular final length.
negative: In blocked only, after the first accepted cutting advance but BEFORE its fresh post-advance observation, cover the entire estimator RGB-D view with a simulated opaque shutter (uniform grey RGB, depth 20 mm) for all remaining renders. This is sensor-input occlusion, not a mesh collision. Require previous access to a sighted front, actual advance, no visual fix or scissors while blocked, no closure, zero structural growth, bounded visibility-related FAILED and no faults/tear. Expected refusal is a control pass, never task completion.
reference: Re-run the unchanged strict truth task with the v1.10 marked optics at the same view, require exact trace identity with validation/task/m5b_v1_10_marked_truth.json, 10 mm, DONE and no tear or faults. Do not claim evidence of comparative benefit or noise robustness from these single-seed development runs.
